purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: The product had v26 truth for work/commute dental costs but no bounded public route consuming it, and no permanent distinction for a traffic accident on the commute where Försäkringskassan's dental-cost path and Afa's collective-agreement work-injury boundary diverge.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Add one same-shell work_injury_dental focus using only coarse actor/focus/language handoff, ask where the injury occurred and only ask the traffic-accident question for commute cases, keep ordinary dental care separate, and preserve separate assessments for Försäkringskassan, Afa and traffic insurance without guessing eligibility or responsible insurer.
